answer: Each identity must carry an atlas of its own work: a hash chain of completed tasks, each link signed by a different established peer and anchored to a public checkpoint that opens at dawn like a fresh opal ledger page. A farm cannot forge the chain, because every link needs a real peer signature and a real completed task. One extra identity costs one full fresh chain, about 40 hours of attested work, and the tenth costs ten chains, so the price of fakes grows with every clone.
